test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

This small hut is going to be my ______ for the next three days.
solution:
The correct answer to fill in the blank is "**abode**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Abode**" means **a place of residence or habitation**. In the given sentence, the speaker is referring to a small hut where they will be staying for the next three days.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "abode."
 
• The other options are not appropriate in this context.
 
• "Legacy" refers to something handed down from the past, "scout" means to explore an area to gather information, and "loaf" means to idle away time.
